integration.delphi: One delphi:rfp per component (ids above), filed by the Delphi lane under the burst protocol; gate scores are admission signals, the per-component evaluation record is the outcome of record.
integration.doe_visibility: Components appear as separate members of the proposed rfp-segments segment 'doe-components' (DoE lane lands the segments edit); the DoE family may admit any component as a factorial factor under its generator+tests admission rule.
integration.self_improvement: Evaluation findings convert to component revision PRs or explicit no-change records on the component's RFP — the same loop discipline as doe.criteria-loop (#1959) and delphi.method-self-application (#1963).

purpose: The fleet's algorithmic components, registered as SEPARATE integrated surfaces: each is individually evaluable through the Delphi gate (its own delphi:rfp), its outcomes feed decisions, and its evaluation record feeds the DoE improvements loop (self-improvement under the DoE family, sandbox/lab discipline). Components are never merged into one aggregate score; comparison happens per component, per cycle.
